thread:
mira: Quick check — we need a short snapshot on the OptKit delivery before tomorrow's devex demo. Main asks: (1) quant recommendations for LLaMA-2-70B artifacts, (2) batching/caching tune suggestions, (3) a regression alert summary from evals, (4) any PRs blocking rollout. Who's owning what?

jerome: I can own the quant packaging and final recommendation doc. ETA EOD. Current thoughts: prefer 4-bit Q8-like FP4 path for 70B to keep latency under control. Need to run one more FP4 vs NF4 perf sweep.

sahil: I'll own batching. Quick numbers from local runs: p50 ~ 120ms, p95 ~ 420ms with continuous batching at batch_size=8, seq=512. If we bump batch to 12 we get ~15% throughput up but p95 jumps ~20%. Propose: default batch=8, adaptive burst to 12 for background workloads.

elaine: I'll take cache invalidation and the eval regression. Found a race in prefix cache eviction that can return stale scores for reranker tests. Small patch in PR #4527 — needs one more review.

mira: Great. @jerome can you post the FP4 vs NF4 numbers as a short table? @sahil can you add the tuning suggestions to OptKit README under /configs? Also flag any infra knobs we need.

jerome: pasted quick numbers:
```
model variant | tokens/sec | p50 | p95
---------------------------------
NF4           | 85         | 130ms | 480ms
FP4-like      | 98         | 118ms | 410ms
```
FP4-like wins on throughput and p95 on our benchmark. Caveat: slight quality diff on long-context summarization (3-4% BLEU-ish).

sahil: Added a draft config: `/optkit/configs/batching/adaptive_v1.yaml` with knobs: max_batch=12, base_batch=8, max_latency_ms=500, backoff=0.8. Pushed wip PR #4531 — needs review and a perf smoke.

elaine: CI looks flaky for reranker evals — ci-bot shows 2 failing tests related to cache eviction (tests: rerank_integration::{test_stale_prefix,test_kv_eviction}). I think my patch fixes them, but need a green run.

ci-bot: CI status: branch optkit/quant-packaging — 3 checks pending, 2 failed (rerank_integration tests). See: https://ci.redwood/optkit/branches/optkit/quant-packaging

jerome: @mira ping for review on PR #4523 (quant artifacts + packaging script). I left notes about reproducibility.

mira: Reviewing now. Quick note: for the demo we should pin the model variant to FP4-like in deployment manifest so we don't get auto-fallback to NF4 during spike. Also add a rollback plan in the runbook.

sahil: Will coordinate with eng-runtime to ensure adaptive_burst is respected in canary. @eng-runtime-team please hold burst policy for demo window 10:00-11:00 PST.

elaine: After CI is green I'll merge #4527 and then re-run the eval suite. If regressions persist I'll post a concise alert with diffs.

mira: Thanks all. Action items: jerome=publish FP4 vs NF4 artifact + PR review, sahil=finalize adaptive config + confirm runtime knobs, elaine=merge cache fix + re-run evals. Devex: can you add a 10m demo blurb that notes pinned variant + perf caveats? :thumbsup:

devex-bot: Added demo blurb to the devex agenda: "OptKit: quantized FP4-like demo (p50~120ms, p95~420ms). Rollback: fallback to NF4. Key risks: minor quality diffs on long-context summarization." Link: https://console.redwood/devex/agenda/196543

mira: If CI goes green and PRs merged, we target a canary rollout tonight at 22:00 PST. Otherwise postpone. I'll post a final go/no-go by 20:00. :eyes:
